input.text: Which outgoing wires need a callback?

clauses.text: Outgoing wires of $10,000 or more require a callback to the customer at a number already on file.
clauses.title: Wire Transfer FAQ

clauses.text: Outgoing wires of $10,000 or more require a callback that a wire specialist completes.
clauses.title: Commercial Wire Services Policy

clauses.text: Outgoing wires over $100,000 need a second approval from an operations manager.
